    Linear Hom spaces and finite biproducts #

    Small reusable linear-algebra interfaces for passing between morphisms into a finite biproduct and the family of their components. They are used to turn a chosen Krull--Schmidt middle-term decomposition into the corresponding Hom- dimension sum.
